top_signals.title: Hillhouse-Backed NOTA Said to Target Tokyo IPO in December
top_signals.summary: NOTA Inc. is planning an initial public offering in Tokyo as soon as December, according to people familiar with the matter, setting up what could be one of the larger deals in a down year for Japanese debuts.

top_signals.title: Scott Bessent's growth plans aren't enough to tame surging deficit and debt pile, IMF chief says
top_signals.summary: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva said Bessent’s reliance on growth won’t cut the U.S. deficit and $40 trillion debt fast enough, calling for fiscal consolidation.
